home.title: Inflatable Hire UK | Bouncy Castles, Assault Courses & Rodeo Bulls
home.meta: Inflatable hire across the UK from JM Entertainment – bouncy castles, slides, assault courses, inflatable games, Wipeout and rodeo bulls. Check live availability.
home.intro: Bouncy castles, giant slides, assault courses, inflatable games, Wipeout challenges and rodeo bulls for corporate fun days, schools, festivals and family parties. Every hire is delivered, set up and collected by our own crew, with live availability straight from our booking system.

sections.h2: Inflatable hire for every kind of event
sections.html:
From a single bouncy castle for a garden party to a 220ft obstacle course, rodeo bull and a field full of inflatable games for a corporate fun day, JM Inflatable Hire has the stock and the crew to make it happen. Everything you see on this site is our own stock, kept in our own warehouse and set up by our own team.

Every hire includes delivery, professional set-up, a full safety check and collection. Add operators and staff so your guests are looked after all day, or combine inflatables with arcade games, simulators and side stalls from the wider JM Entertainment range.

• Huge range in one place – castles, slides, assault courses, games, challenges and rodeo rides.
  • Live stock and availability straight from our booking system, so you know what's free before you call.
  • Fixed, clear pricing with multi-day discounts shown on every product.
  • Safety first – PIPA-tested inflatables, PAT-tested blowers and trained, DBS-checked crew.
  • Nationwide coverage for corporate events, schools, councils, festivals and private parties.
  • Fully insured, with risk assessments supplied once you've booked.

sections.h2: Popular for corporate fun days, schools and festivals
sections.html: Our inflatables are booked for staff summer parties, family fun days, team building, school sports days and summer fairs, university freshers' events, shopping-centre activations, council events, festivals, weddings and birthday parties. Mix and match – assault course races, a Gladiators duel and a rodeo bull together make a brilliant It's-a-Knockout style day.

faq.q: How much does inflatable hire cost?
faq.a: Bouncy castles start from £85 + VAT per day and larger event inflatables such as assault courses, Wipeout and rodeo bulls start from around £450–£695 + VAT. Delivery, set-up and collection are included on most UK bookings. Multi-day hires are discounted – a two-day hire costs roughly 1.5 days and longer hires work out cheaper per day. Each inflatable's page shows 1, 2, 3, 4 and 7-day prices.
Yes. Our crews deliver, set up and collect across England, Scotland and Wales – from London and the South East to Manchester, Birmingham, Leeds, Newcastle, Glasgow and Cardiff.
Most inflatables run from one standard 13 amp socket within 25 metres for the electric blower. No power on site? We can supply a petrol blower or generator – just ask when you book.

faq.q: Can inflatables be used outdoors on grass?
faq.a: Yes – grass is ideal. We stake every inflatable down and supply safety mats. On hard ground or indoors we use sandbags and crash mats instead. Inflatables can't be used in high winds or heavy rain, so our crew will advise on the day.

Every inflatable is PIPA tested, cleaned and checked before each hire, and all blowers are PAT tested. We hold public liability insurance; risk assessments and insurance documents are supplied once your booking is confirmed.

sections.h2: Bouncy castles for adults and children
sections.html: Our range runs from compact 10ft x 10ft garden castles to adult bouncy castles with full rain roofs. Themed castles – jungle, farmyard, undersea, princess, dinosaur and Peppa Pig – are perfect for children's birthday parties, while disco domes with lights and music turn any evening do into a party.

sections.h2: How much space does a bouncy castle need?
sections.html: Allow the size of the castle plus around 1–2 metres on each side for the blower, safety mats and access. A typical children's castle needs about 4m x 5m and roughly 3.5m of height; adult castles need more. Exact sizes come with your quote so you can be sure it fits your garden, hall or marquee.
Every castle is PIPA tested, cleaned after each hire and installed by our crew with stakes or sandbags and safety mats. We'll talk you through safe use when we set up, and collect at the agreed time.
